# SaltWatch 2.2.5

This release makes SaltWatch notifications easier to read and expands the
visual installation guidance.

## Clearer Home Assistant notifications

- Rounded salt-level percentages to whole numbers in low-salt, reminder, and
  recovery notifications.
- Rounded forecast day counts to whole numbers.
- Added regression checks to keep notification values free of decimals.

## Improved installation guidance

- Added a privacy-safe screenshot of the organized local SaltWatch interface.
- Added a full-width annotated installation gallery showing the sensor, tank
  interior, and no-drill cable route.
- Updated the hardware and mounting guidance to match the photographed setup.

There are no measurement, calibration, forecast, or connectivity behavior
changes in this release. Existing Wi-Fi credentials, Home Assistant API
encryption, calibration, and forecast data are preserved during the managed
update.
